mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping preserves cross-checking dispersed records, ordering compatible dated links, and marking gaps to reconstruct a bounded documented history. Missing, copied, ambiguous records and undocumented transitions retain the source's central evidential limits.

target_fidelity.rationale: The mapping offers an explicitly bounded contribution: documented leaf histories constrain possible assembly sequences while leaving revision dates uncertain. It does not claim that custody establishes composition or that these constraints uniquely identify the best revision sequence.

operational_coherence.rationale: Cross-checking manuscript marks and dated records can establish supported locations and transfers, yielding chronological constraints on possible assembly. The inference stays within those constraints and explicitly avoids equating custody with composition.

validity.rationale: All three criteria pass because the mapping transfers documentary reconstruction faithfully and makes a bounded contribution to the retained assembly-and-revision question.

uncertainty: The packet supplies no inspected records, so the actual chronology, record independence, and strength of assembly constraints remain unknown.
Custody evidence alone may leave multiple assembly sequences compatible and cannot establish revision dates.
